meta.title: The two-sided ledger
meta.question: Where do customers get more than they value, and where less?
caveats: Group-level: each value is the share of a cohort, not of a person.
Cohorts below n = 25 are listed but not compared (usable = false).
Pairs P01–P07 set what decision-makers value against what they receive; C01–C02 set what salespeople know about themselves against what they know about the customer.
Gap = b − a. For value-vs-experience pairs: received − valued.
meta.provenance: Pairs are Claude's inference (INFERRED), confirmed by Scott 2026-10-30 (Q-P4a). Values RECON_DATA via T04.
